सुपरस्टार Rajinikanth की मच-अवेटेड फिल्म Dharman को लेकर एक बहुत ही धमाकेदार खबर सामने आई है! 🎬

पहले Thalaivar 173 नाम से जानी जाने वाली इस फिल्म में Rajinikanth और Kamal Haasan पहली बार साथ आए हैं, जहां Kamal Haasan इसे प्रोड्यूस कर रहे हैं। अब इस बड़ी फिल्म में तेलुगु सिनेमा के स्टार Ram Pothineni यानी आपके प्यारे RAPO की भी एंट्री हो चुकी है! 🔥

Devadasu, Ready, Kandireega और iSmart Shankar जैसी हिट फिल्में देने वाले Ram Pothineni इस प्रोजेक्ट से अपना Tamil debut करने जा रहे हैं। Rajinikanth के साथ वे पहली बार स्क्रीन शेयर करेंगे, हालांकि उनके किरदार की डिटेल्स अभी गुप्त रखी गई हैं। 💥

Ashwath Marimuthu के डायरेक्शन में बन रही इस फिल्म को Raajkamal Films International के बैनर तले Kamal Haasan और R. Mahendran प्रोड्यूस कर रहे हैं। फिल्म का म्यूजिक Anirudh Ravichander दे रहे हैं और एक्शन Anbariv कोरियोग्राफ करेंगे।

क्या आप Rajinikanth और Ram Pothineni की इस नई जोड़ी को बड़े पर्दे पर देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? हमें कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Dharman: Ram Pothineni Joins Rajinikanth’s Film, Marks His Tamil Cinema Debut
ctx.summary:
Ram Pothineni joins Rajinikanth’s Dharman, marking his Tamil cinema debut and first collaboration with the superstar in Kamal Haasan’s film. 
 The post  Dharman: Ram Pothineni Joins Rajinikanth’s Film, Marks His Tamil Cinema Debut  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rajinikanth’s much-awaited film Dharman has created immense buzz ever since it was announced. Earlier titled Thalaivar 173, it grabbed audience attention with the mega collaboration between two superstars, Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan. This marks their first venture together, with Kamal Haasan stepping in as a producer and Rajinikanth leading the film. Adding to the buzz, the film now has a new addition to its cast, which has further fueled the excitement.
Telugu actor Ram Pothineni has joined the project, fueling excitement among fans of Telugu and Tamil cinema. The film marks his first Tamil film and his first time sharing the screen space with Rajinikanth . The casting brings together two actors from different film industries for the first time.
Popularly known as RAPO among fans, Ram Pothineni has worked in several successful Telugu films. He made his debut with Devadasu and went on to star in films such as Ready, Kandireega, and iSmart Shankar.
With Dharman, Ram Pothineni marks an exciting new milestone in his career, making his much-awaited Tamil cinema debut. More interestingly, this will also be his first-time collaboration with superstar Rajinikanth. Details about his character and role in the film have not been revealed yet.
Dharman, starring Rajinikanth, is directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and produced by Kamal Haasan under his banner, Raajkamal Films International. It is also co-produced by R. Mahendran, with the action choreographed by Anbariv and the music composed by Anirudh Ravichander.
